name: 31981-longctxmtp-dsv4flashfp8-tp8
model: sgl-project/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-FP8 -- the FP8 repackage, because upstream `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash` has FP4 routed experts that want Blackwell or the marlin runner.
parallelism: TP=8, EP=8, PP=1, DP=1, expert-parallel load balancing off.
architecture: DeepseekV4ForCausalLM, 43 layers, MLA plus DeepSeek sparse attention, 256 routed experts + 1 shared (top-6), one nextn head, block-FP8 weights, 294.1 GB over 55 files.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=192, bounded at 1536 requests with a 5400 s safety cap, warmup the first 25%.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, 1024 prompt tokens and 1024 output tokens both fixed, `ignore_eos`, temperature 0, seed 42.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant on a mixture-of-experts model, serving 192 concurrent users 1024-token prompts and replies across eight GPUs.
launch:
model-path: sgl-project/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-FP8
trust-remote-code: true

# ep-size is not implied by tp-size: it defaults to 1.
tp-size: 8
ep-size: 8

# EAGLE with topk 1 is asserted for this architecture, and topk 1 additionally requires
# num_draft_tokens == num_steps + 1.
speculative-algorithm: EAGLE
speculative-num-steps: 3
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 4

context-length: 131072

# Explicit because the speculative startup hook writes 48 into this field whenever it is unset.
max-running-requests: 256

# The default capture list stops short of 192.
cuda-graph-max-bs: 192

mem-fraction-static: 0.85
